notes.title: My Little Pony: A Maretime Bay Adventure Trading Cards are here!
notes.content:
Calling Everypony!

Put your hooves into action and continue to enjoy the Maretime Bay Adventure with Sunny and the pony gang by unlocking and collecting trading cards, badges, and more.


 7 Stylish Trading cards 
 6 Magical Badges 
 5 Ponified Profile backgrounds 
 5 Enchanted Emoticons 


Saddle up and enjoy the extraordinary adventure!
